description: This file contains SQLAlchemy ORM model definitions for the Superset reporting system, including classes for report schedules, recipients, and execution logs, along with related enums and table configurations.

classes.name: ReportScheduleType
classes.description: Enum for report schedule types: Alert or Report

classes.name: ReportScheduleValidatorType
classes.description: Enum for validator types used in alerts

classes.name: ReportRecipientType
classes.description: Enum for recipient types such as Email, Slack, Webhook

classes.name: ReportState
classes.description: Enum for report states: Success, Working, Error, Noop, Grace

classes.name: ReportDataFormat
classes.description: Enum for report data formats: PDF, PNG, CSV, TEXT

classes.name: ReportCreationMethod
classes.description: Enum for creation methods: charts, dashboards, alerts_reports

classes.name: ReportSourceFormat
classes.description: Enum for source formats: chart, dashboard

classes.name: ReportSchedule
classes.description: Model representing scheduled reports and alerts, with properties for configuration, relationships, and methods for native filter params

classes.name: ReportRecipients
classes.description: Model for report notification recipients supporting multiple types

classes.name: ReportExecutionLog
classes.description: Model for logging report execution results, timestamps, and errors

methods.name: crontab_humanized
methods.description: Returns a human-readable description of the crontab schedule

methods.name: get_native_filters_params
methods.description: Generates URL-encoded parameters for native filters based on dashboard configuration

methods.name: _generate_native_filter
methods.description: Helper method to generate filter parameters for different filter types
